Key details

  • What does it mean?
  • When we take a substance in the form of a bulk and it has a certain strength.
  • But when you come to the nanomaterial range, it is found that the strength increases to a great extent.
  • Bulk copper we know can be bent with certain amount of ease.
  • We take these copper particles in the nano range, like when you get it to below 50 nanometers, it is found that they become super hard in nature.
  • The same copper which in the form of bulk could be bent cannot.
  • We bend now and it becomes super hard and it loses all its malleability and deductivity, which we find in the case of bulk copper.

  • And because of these imperfections or these vacancies and dislocations, etcetera, we find that the strength of the material.
